suite: annotate sweep rail (the mechanism, contributors, re-pick, bind snapshot)
expect_red: [real] the hub spindle bore axis end opens to the contact engine's faces, the top-ranked first, each naming its class and radius and why it is there, then show all and Pick another face

mutations.contract: A candidate row names its face the way the armed pick does: number, class, fitted radius.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_joint_end_lists_its_candidate_faces_and_says_why_each_is_there (2026-11-03). Without the class and radius every row on the hub's list is a bare face number, which is the line the armed pick replaced on 2026-10-29.
mutations.find: return AA.preselectWords(row.faceId, row.surface ? { surface: row.surface, radius: row.radius || 0 } : null);
